concepts.label: Tax salience
concepts.definition: The prominence or visibility of taxes to taxpayers when making economic decisions.
concepts.more_means: higher awareness or visibility of taxes

concepts.label: Public sector employment
concepts.definition: Employment within government-owned or controlled organizations.
concepts.more_means: working in the public sector

concepts.label: Children and fertility
concepts.definition: The presence, number, or addition of children in a household.
concepts.more_means: having more children or experiencing childbirth

concepts.label: Grandparental labor supply
concepts.definition: The relative labor supply or employment status of maternal versus paternal grandparents.
concepts.more_means: higher relative labor supply of grandparents
phrases: relative labor supply of the maternal grandparents
relative labor supply of the paternal grandparents

concepts.label: Parental death
concepts.definition: The occurrence of a parent's death.
concepts.more_means: experiencing the death of a parent

concepts.label: Liquidity constraints
concepts.definition: The inability of an individual or firm to raise cash quickly to meet financial obligations or opportunities.
concepts.more_means: being more liquidity constrained

concepts.label: Firm size
concepts.definition: The scale of a firm, typically measured by its number of employees.
concepts.more_means: larger firm size

concepts.label: Health shock
concepts.definition: An unexpected and severe adverse health event.
concepts.more_means: experiencing a severe health shock

concepts.label: Fatal health shock
concepts.definition: A sudden health event resulting in death.
concepts.more_means: experiencing a fatal health shock

concepts.label: Severe nonfatal health shock
concepts.definition: A severe health event that does not result in death.
concepts.more_means: experiencing a severe nonfatal health shock

concepts.label: Within-firm earner rank
concepts.definition: An individual's relative earnings position within their employing firm.
concepts.more_means: higher rank or status within the firm's earnings distribution
phrases: top-five earner status within the firm

concepts.label: Tax enforcement
concepts.definition: Actions taken by tax authorities to monitor or enforce compliance.
concepts.more_means: greater exposure to tax enforcement actions

concepts.label: Tax audits
concepts.definition: Formal examinations of tax returns by tax authorities.
concepts.more_means: being subjected to a prior tax audit

concepts.label: Threat-of-audit letters
concepts.definition: Communications from tax authorities warning of a potential audit.
concepts.more_means: receiving a threat-of-audit letter

concepts.label: Net-of-tax rate
concepts.rationale: Marginal tax rate and net-of-tax rate are mirror images of the same concept.
concepts.definition: The share of income kept by the taxpayer after taxes (1 minus the marginal tax rate).
concepts.more_means: keeping a larger share of marginal income

concepts.label: Net-of-tax rate on capital income
concepts.definition: The net-of-tax rate applied specifically to capital gains or investment income.
concepts.more_means: keeping a larger share of marginal capital income
phrases: marginal net-of-tax rate on capital income

concepts.label: Net-of-tax rate on labor income
concepts.rationale: V007 represents a tax reform that reduces marginal tax rates, which increases the net-of-tax rate on labor income.
concepts.definition: The net-of-tax rate applied specifically to labor earnings.
concepts.more_means: keeping a larger share of marginal labor earnings
phrases: marginal net-of-tax rate on labor income
tax reform reducing marginal tax rates

concepts.label: Import competition
concepts.definition: The level of exposure of local markets or firms to foreign import competition.
concepts.more_means: greater exposure to foreign imports

concepts.label: Gender gap in earnings
concepts.rationale: These phrases represent the relative earnings gap between genders, including the child penalty which is a key driver of this gap.
concepts.definition: The difference in earnings between men and women, including child penalties.
concepts.more_means: larger earnings gap or child penalty for women relative to men

concepts.label: Gender gap in hours worked
concepts.rationale: Measures the gender gap in the intensive margin of labor supply.
concepts.definition: The difference in weekly hours worked between men and women.
concepts.more_means: larger gap in hours worked between men and women

concepts.label: Gender gap in labor force participation
concepts.rationale: Measures the gender gap in the extensive margin of labor supply.
concepts.definition: The difference in labor force participation rates between men and women.
concepts.more_means: larger gap in labor force participation between men and women

concepts.label: Gender gap in wage rates
concepts.rationale: Measures the gender gap in hourly wage rates.
concepts.definition: The difference in hourly wage rates between men and women.
concepts.more_means: larger gap in hourly wage rates between men and women

concepts.label: Relative probability of working in a family-friendly firm
concepts.rationale: Measures the sorting of women into family-friendly firms relative to men.
concepts.definition: The probability of women working in family-friendly firms relative to men.
concepts.more_means: higher relative probability of women working in family-friendly firms
phrases: probability of working in a family-friendly firm for women relative to men

concepts.label: Relative probability of becoming manager
concepts.rationale: Measures the gender gap in the likelihood of holding managerial positions.
concepts.definition: The probability of women becoming managers relative to men.
concepts.more_means: higher relative probability of women becoming managers
phrases: probability of becoming manager for women relative to men

concepts.label: Relative occupational rank
concepts.rationale: Measures the relative position of women in occupational hierarchies compared to men.
concepts.definition: The occupational rank of women relative to men.
concepts.more_means: higher occupational rank of women relative to men
phrases: occupational rank of women relative to men

concepts.label: Relative probability of working in the public sector
concepts.rationale: Measures the sorting of women into public sector employment relative to men.
concepts.definition: The probability of women working in the public sector relative to men.
concepts.more_means: higher relative probability of women working in the public sector
phrases: probability of working in the public sector for women relative to men

concepts.label: Mental health service use
concepts.rationale: These phrases measure the utilization of healthcare resources for mental health conditions.
concepts.definition: The utilization of mental health treatments, prescriptions, or psychological assistance.
concepts.more_means: greater use of mental health services or prescriptions

concepts.label: Opioid prescriptions
concepts.rationale: Measures the volume or likelihood of receiving opioid prescriptions.
concepts.definition: The prescription and use of opioid medications.
concepts.more_means: more opioid prescriptions

concepts.label: Legal tax avoidance
concepts.rationale: Measures legal behavioral responses to minimize tax liability.
concepts.definition: The use of legal methods to minimize the amount of income tax owed.
concepts.more_means: more legal tax avoidance

concepts.label: Capital income
concepts.rationale: Measures income generated from capital rather than labor.
concepts.definition: Income derived from capital assets, such as dividends, interest, or capital gains.
concepts.more_means: higher capital income

concepts.label: Household post-transfer income
concepts.rationale: Measures household-level income after taxes and transfers.
concepts.definition: The total disposable income of a household after receiving government transfers.
concepts.more_means: higher household post-transfer income

concepts.label: Reported income
concepts.definition: Income reported to tax authorities, categorized by reporting source.
concepts.more_means: higher reported income

concepts.label: Self-reported income
concepts.rationale: Measures income that is self-reported by the taxpayer, which is more prone to evasion.
concepts.definition: Income reported to tax authorities directly by the taxpayer.
concepts.more_means: higher self-reported income

concepts.label: Third-party reported income
concepts.rationale: Measures income reported by third parties, which is highly verifiable.
concepts.definition: Income reported to tax authorities by a third party, such as an employer.
concepts.more_means: higher third-party reported income

concepts.label: Income shifting
concepts.rationale: These phrases represent the behavior, share, and prevalence of shifting income to minimize tax liability.
concepts.definition: The practice of moving income across tax periods or categories to minimize tax liability.
concepts.more_means: more active income shifting behavior

concepts.label: Tax evasion
concepts.rationale: Measures the extent of illegal tax evasion on self-reported income.
concepts.definition: The illegal non-payment or underpayment of tax.
concepts.more_means: greater tax evasion

concepts.label: Taxable income
concepts.rationale: These phrases measure income that is subject to taxation, with or without adjustment for shifting.
concepts.definition: The amount of income used to calculate an individual's or household's income tax liability.
concepts.more_means: higher taxable income
phrases: taxable income excluding the shifting component

concepts.label: Earnings
concepts.rationale: These phrases all describe individual earnings or labor income from employment.
concepts.definition: The financial compensation received by an individual in exchange for their labor.
concepts.more_means: higher individual earnings

concepts.label: Labor supply
concepts.rationale: These phrases represent different ways of measuring labor supply, either on the intensive margin (hours) or extensive margin (participation).
concepts.definition: The amount of individual effort or time offered for paid work, including participation and hours.
concepts.more_means: greater labor force participation or hours worked

concepts.label: Occupational employment
concepts.definition: Employment levels across different occupational categories.
concepts.more_means: higher employment in specific occupations

concepts.label: Employment in high-wage occupations
concepts.rationale: Measures employment specifically in high-wage occupations.
concepts.definition: Employment in occupations that pay high average wages.
concepts.more_means: more employment in high-wage occupations

concepts.label: Employment in low-wage occupations
concepts.rationale: Measures employment specifically in low-wage occupations.
concepts.definition: Employment in occupations that pay low average wages.
concepts.more_means: more employment in low-wage occupations

concepts.label: Employment in mid-wage occupations
concepts.rationale: Measures employment specifically in mid-wage occupations.
concepts.definition: Employment in occupations that pay middle-range average wages.
concepts.more_means: more employment in mid-wage occupations

concepts.label: Timing of first birth
concepts.rationale: Captures individual-level variation in the timing of transition to parenthood.
concepts.definition: The specific timing or age at which an individual has their first child.
concepts.more_means: later timing of first birth

concepts.label: IVF treatment success
concepts.rationale: Both phrases leverage IVF success at the first treatment as a natural experiment; the sub-populations (childless women vs mothers) represent sample stratifications rather than different variables.
concepts.definition: Whether the first IVF treatment was successful in resulting in a birth.
concepts.more_means: successful IVF treatment
phrases: ivf treatment success at the first ivf treatment among childless women
ivf treatment success at the first ivf treatment among childless women and among mothers

concepts.label: Parental death shock
concepts.rationale: Captures the sudden loss of a parent as an exogenous family shock.
concepts.definition: The occurrence and timing of a sudden first parental death.
concepts.more_means: experiencing a parental death shock
phrases: timing of sudden first parental deaths

concepts.label: Spousal death shock
concepts.rationale: Captures the sudden loss of a spouse as an exogenous family shock.
concepts.definition: The occurrence and timing of a spouse's death.
concepts.more_means: experiencing a spousal death shock
phrases: timing of spousal death within a short window

concepts.label: Spousal health shock
concepts.rationale: Captures non-fatal sudden health shocks to a spouse.
concepts.definition: The occurrence of a sudden severe health event in a spouse, such as a heart attack or stroke.
concepts.more_means: experiencing a spousal health shock
phrases: timing of a spouse's first heart attack or stroke within a short window

concepts.label: Marginal tax rate changes
concepts.rationale: These phrases all capture variation in marginal tax rates, whether through specific historical Danish tax reforms (1987, 1994, 1999, 2004, 2010) or kinks in the tax schedule.
concepts.definition: Changes in marginal tax rates induced by legislative tax reforms or tax schedule kinks.
concepts.more_means: larger changes or higher marginal tax rates
phrases: jumps in marginal tax rates at large kinks in the danish income tax and stock income tax schedules
the 1987 reform's differential changes in marginal tax rates
the 1987, 1994, 1999 and 2004 reforms' differential changes in marginal tax rates
the 1994, 1999 and 2004 reforms' differential changes in marginal tax rates
the danish 2010 tax reform's differential cut in marginal tax rates for high-wage earners

concepts.label: Tax audit exposure
concepts.rationale: Both phrases capture randomized assignment to audits or threat-of-audit letters, which manipulate the perceived or actual probability of being audited.
concepts.definition: The assignment to or threat of a tax audit.
concepts.more_means: higher probability of being audited or receiving an audit threat letter

concepts.label: Import competition exposure
concepts.rationale: This represents the exogenous shock of trade liberalization from China's WTO entry.
concepts.definition: Exposure to increased foreign trade competition, specifically from the removal of import quotas.
concepts.more_means: greater exposure to import competition
phrases: removal of multi-fiber arrangement import quotas on chinese textiles and clothing upon china's wto entry

left_out.why: This phrase combines two distinct sources of exogenous variation (IVF treatment success and twin births) into a single description.

concepts.label: Family economics and household production
concepts.rationale: Both phrases describe theoretical mechanisms operating at the household or family level, including support channels, child quality, and household production.
concepts.definition: Theories of household production, child quality, economies of scale, and family support channels.
concepts.more_means: greater alignment with family economics and household production theories
phrases: mental health and family support channels
standard theories of household production, child quality, and economies of scale

concepts.label: Income shifting models
concepts.rationale: Represents models of intertemporal income shifting.
concepts.definition: Theoretical models describing the intertemporal or cross-category shifting of income for tax optimization.
concepts.more_means: greater alignment with income shifting models

concepts.label: Labor supply models
concepts.rationale: Both phrases represent theoretical models of labor supply, either traditional extensions or family-level self-insurance.
concepts.definition: Theoretical models of labor supply, including traditional extensions and family self-insurance mechanisms.
concepts.more_means: greater alignment with labor supply theory
phrases: family labor supply as a self-insurance mechanism
simple extension of the traditional labor supply model

concepts.label: Social and gender norms
concepts.rationale: Represents models incorporating gender identity and social norms.
concepts.definition: Theoretical frameworks incorporating social norms, identity, and gender roles into economic models.
concepts.more_means: greater emphasis on social and gender identity norms

concepts.label: Tax evasion and compliance models
concepts.rationale: Represents the Allingham-Sandmo tax evasion model.
concepts.definition: Theoretical frameworks explaining tax evasion behavior, such as the Allingham-Sandmo model with risk considerations.
concepts.more_means: greater alignment with tax evasion and compliance theory
phrases: allingham–sandmo (henceforth as) model with risk-neutral taxpayers and an endogenous audit probability

concepts.label: Trade theory models
concepts.rationale: Represents the factor service trade perspective in trade theory.
concepts.definition: Theoretical frameworks analyzing international trade, such as the factor service trade perspective.
concepts.more_means: greater alignment with trade theory models

concepts.label: Elasticity of tax avoidance and evasion
concepts.rationale: Both tax evasion and tax avoidance represent behavioral sheltering responses to reduce tax liability.
concepts.definition: The responsiveness of tax avoidance or evasion behaviors to changes in tax rates.
concepts.more_means: greater responsiveness of tax sheltering, avoidance, or evasion to tax rates
phrases: compensated elasticity of tax evasion with respect to the net-of-tax rate

concepts.label: Elasticity of capital income
concepts.rationale: Identifies the own-tax elasticity of capital income.
concepts.definition: The percentage change in capital income in response to a one percent change in the marginal net-of-tax rate on capital income.
concepts.more_means: greater responsiveness of capital income to capital tax rate changes
phrases: elasticity of capital income with respect to the marginal net-of-tax rate

concepts.label: Cross-tax elasticity of capital income to labor tax rate
concepts.rationale: Identifies the cross-tax elasticity of capital income with respect to the labor tax rate.
concepts.definition: The percentage change in capital income in response to a one percent change in the marginal net-of-tax rate on labor income.
concepts.more_means: greater cross-responsiveness of capital income to labor tax rates
phrases: cross-tax elasticity of capital income with respect to the marginal net-of-tax rate on labor income

concepts.label: Cross-tax elasticity of labor income to capital tax rate
concepts.rationale: Identifies the cross-tax elasticity of labor income with respect to the capital tax rate.
concepts.definition: The percentage change in labor income in response to a one percent change in the marginal net-of-tax rate on capital income.
concepts.more_means: greater cross-responsiveness of labor income to capital tax rates
phrases: cross-tax elasticity of labor income with respect to the marginal net-of-tax rate on capital income

concepts.label: Elasticity of taxable income
concepts.rationale: This is the standard elasticity of taxable income (ETI) parameter.
concepts.definition: The percentage change in taxable income in response to a one percent change in the net-of-tax rate.
concepts.more_means: greater responsiveness of taxable income to tax rate changes

concepts.label: Elasticity of labor income
concepts.rationale: Identifies the own-tax elasticity of labor income.
concepts.definition: The percentage change in labor income in response to a one percent change in the marginal net-of-tax rate on labor income.
concepts.more_means: greater responsiveness of labor income to labor tax rate changes
phrases: elasticity of labor income with respect to the marginal net-of-tax rate
